messages:
Marta (PM): Quick sync — Sales flagged an urgent ask from NovaPay: they want a cheap, predictable inference tier we can ship quickly. Tentative name 'Edge Lite'.
Andre (Sales): NovaPay is explicit: must be ~3x cheaper than hosted, basic streaming fine, function-calling not required for v1. They'll sign pilots if cost + SLOs look good.
Devin (Eng): Clarify 'basic streaming': partial token streaming ok? or only response-at-end? Streaming adds infra and perf work.
Priya (Solutions): For most intents, partial streaming (start-of-stream + status tokens) is fine. They care more about cost and predictable p50 for 512 tok.
Sangeeta (ProdOps): Two product trade paths: full feature parity with existing API (takes longer) vs a constrained variant optimized for quantized models and smaller KV cache. We need to pick.
Devin (Eng): Constraint variant easier: quantized FP16->INT8 pipelines, smaller caches, pre-baked routing to lower-capacity nodes. Risks: dev experience fragmentation and longer-term support cost.
Tom (SRE): From SRE side, we can spin a new capacity pool with reduced burst and stricter timeouts. Ops cost should be 30-40% lower if we lock to quantized models and disable large-context KV growth.
Marta (PM): Proposed scope compromise: v1 = cost-first 'Edge Lite' WITHOUT function calling, WITH partial streaming, explicit model whitelist, and a compatibility shim for the existing client SDK. v2 later adds full parity.
Andre (Sales): NovaPay will accept that compromise. Need clear launch criteria for pilot: cost delta, latency SLO, and an integration checklist.
Priya (Solutions): Integration checklist suggestion:
- SDK shim: auto-fallback to Edge Lite endpoint when customer opts in
- Docs: migration guide with known limitations
- Test prompts + perf harness for 512/1024 tokens
Devin (Eng): Engineering acceptance criteria:
- p50 < 120ms for 512 tokens (90% of traffic synthetic)
- tail (p99) < 600ms under pilot load
- 3x token-cost reduction vs standard hosted for same model mix
- Backward-compatible minimal shim — small helper lib, no protocol changes
Sangeeta (ProdOps): Business acceptance: pilot signed, usage threshold >= 50k tokens/month, and support SLA: 99.5% uptime for pilot.
Tom (SRE): Need extra telemetry hooks for cache hit rates and quantization quality. Add a regression alert tied to eval set — if avg embedding coherence drops >5%->auto-rollback.
Marta (PM): Timeline proposal: 3-week spike to validate quantized perf + prototype shim; then 4-week implementation for MVP. Total 7 weeks to pilot.
Devin (Eng): We should split tasks:
- Spike (2 devs): quantized latency profile + model whitelist
- Shim (1 dev): client fallback & docs
- Infra (1 eng + SRE): pool & autoscale rules
- Evals (1 ML): quality guardrails
Priya (Solutions): I'll prepare a NovaPay-ready demo and test prompts during spike.
Andre (Sales): I'll push to get LOI contingent on spike results. Will ask NovaPay to prioritize pilot data on our eval suite.
Marta (PM): Decision check — do we agree to scope v1 as cost-first constrained variant with shim, and to run the 3-week spike? React with :thumbsup: to proceed or reply with concerns.
Devin (Eng): :thumbsup:
Sangeeta (ProdOps): :thumbsup:
Tom (SRE): :thumbsup:
Priya (Solutions): :thumbsup:
Andre (Sales): :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Note: capacity pool template created (edge-lite-pool-1) — do not deploy to prod.
Marta (PM): Great. I'll file the proposal doc and PRD after the spike plan is finalized. Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with tasks.
